articles.summary: Delek US reported a record third quarter net income of $1,133.8 million or $18.22 per share, adjusted net income of $843.0 million or $13.55 per share and adjusted EBITDA of $1,280.4 million Excluding the impacts of the RVO adjustment and SREs granted in the current quarter, adjusted EPS was $10.53 per share and adjusted EBITDA was $1,038.1 million Delek Logistics ("DKL") reported adjusted EBITDA of $142.9 million. Increased annual adjusted EBITDA guidance to $530-560 million Increasing the Enterprise Optimization Plan ("EOP") annual run-rate cash flow improvements guidance to at least $250 million Purchased $50.0 million in DK common stock and expecting to repurchase up to $100 million in 4Q'26 Expects to repay the outstanding $850 million Term Loan during the fourth quarter Paid $15.6 million of dividends and increased regular quarterly dividend by approximately 18% to $0.30 per share Delek US Holdings, Inc. articles.title: Delek US Holdings Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
